description.ar: الشروط الأساسية لاستخدام منصتنا والاستفادة من خدماتنا

description.en: The website provides a connection service between the beneficiary (player or coach) and the other party (coach or player) and bears no responsibility for the results or services provided by the other party. The beneficiary bears full responsibility for their decisions and interaction with other parties.

description.en: The beneficiary (player or coach) pays a non-refundable fee for using the service. All payments are made through the payment methods available on the website. Fees are not refunded in case of incompatibility between parties or for any other reason.

description.en: All information is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. The website does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of any information or content available on the website. Use of the website is at the user's own risk.
